mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id, user_id, namespace, state_key, value_json, revision, created_at, updated_at FROM ds_user_state WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND namespace = #{namespace} ORDER BY state_key
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ds_user_state (tenant_id, user_id, namespace, state_key, value_json, revision, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{entity.tenantId}, #{entity.userId}, #{entity.namespace}, #{entity.stateKey}, #{entity.valueJson}, 0, #{now}, #{now})
